exceptions.title: @babel/core: Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL Comment
exceptions.reason: The patched Babel 8 release is incompatible with the current Next ESLint chain, whose eslint-plugin-react-hooks dependency requires Babel 7. Production dependencies contain no advisory.
exceptions.remediation: Re-evaluate when eslint-plugin-react-hooks removes or updates its Babel 7 dependency; do not process untrusted source maps in lint/build tooling meanwhile.
